exposure: order of T1DM diagnosis (first vs. second sibling)
cohort: The study included 17 sibling pairs (total 34 cases) diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus and followed at a specific clinic between January 2005 and May 2017.
finding: No statistically significant differences were observed between first and second diagnosed siblings regarding age at diagnosis, presenting symptoms, symptom duration, initial glucose/C-peptide, average HbA1c, or hospitalization rates in the first five years, but Vitamin D levels were significantly lower in siblings diagnosed secondarily.
